Turns the report on or off that prints the frames per second and the timers of the runtime once a second, on the standard error output, like setting the environment variable `BLITZLLVM_PROFILE_FPS` to `1` or `0` (which only decides how the program starts). The timers must be running, see [ProfileEnable](ProfileEnable). Without `--profile` this command does nothing.

```blitzbasic
Graphics 64, 64, 0, 2
ProfileFPS 1
Local start = MilliSecs()
While MilliSecs() - start < 2500
	Cls
	Flip
Wend
ProfileFPS 0
```
@param enable  1 to print the report, 0 to stop printing it.
@gap This is a BlitzLLVM extension: the original has no such command.
